description: Source code for a real-time timing notifier in a radio communication system, implementing GPS time synchronization, slot and symbol timing, and notifier subscription management.

classes.name: gps_clock
classes.description: A custom clock implementation providing current GPS time based on system clock and offset.

methods.name: calculate_ns_fraction_from
methods.description: Calculates the fractional nanoseconds within a second from a GPS clock time point.

methods.name: get_symbol_index
methods.description: Calculates the symbol index within a second based on fractional nanoseconds and symbol duration.

methods.name: get_current_system_slot
methods.description: Determines the current system slot number based on GPS time, slot duration, and hyper system frame size.

methods.name: circular_distance
methods.description: Computes the distance between two values with wrap-around consideration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the real-time timing notifier thread and initializes timing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timing notifier thread safely.

methods.name: timing_loop
methods.description: Main loop for timing synchronization, polling, and notification dispatch.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Performs timing calculations, detects missed symbols, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: notify_slot_symbol_point
methods.description: Notifies all subscribed notifiers of a new symbol point.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes notifiers to receive symbol boundary updates.
